# exo_external_in_outlook (Data Source)

Look up an existing ExternalInOutlook object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `allow_list` (String) Maps to the -AllowList parameter.
- `enabled` (String) Maps to the -Enabled parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
